subject: Re: Purchase follow-up and invoice confirmation
text:
Hi,

Quick follow-up on the software add-on I ordered last week. My earlier email may have been unclear, but I need confirmation that the invoice matches the quote before I can release the final payment.

The project deadline is tighter than I expected, and I cannot begin the integration until the license is active. If you can send the corrected invoice by this afternoon, I can process payment immediately and keep the deliverable on track. I'm sorry to rush, but the client has moved the launch date forward.

I have already scheduled testing for tomorrow evening, so any delay now would force me to ask for extra time. I'd rather avoid that if possible. I understand this request is last minute, and I will keep my further replies concise. Please let me know whether anything is missing from my side.

Thanks
